mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seckill_activity (course_id, seckill_price, stock, start_time, end_time, status) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{seckillPrice}, #{stock}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM seckill_activity ORDER BY activity_id DESC

SELECT a.activity_id AS activityId, a.course_id AS courseId, c.title AS courseTitle, c.cover_url AS courseCoverUrl, c.description AS courseDescription, c.price AS coursePrice, a.seckill_price AS seckillPrice, a.stock AS stock, a.start_time AS startTime, a.end_time AS endTime FROM seckill_activity a JOIN course c ON c.course_id = a.course_id WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.end_time > NOW() ORDER BY a.start_time, a.activity_id
mapper.update:
UPDATE seckill_activity
course_id = #{courseId},
seckill_price = #{seckillPrice},
stock = #{stock},
start_time = #{startTime},
end_time = #{endTime},
status = #{status},
WHERE activity_id = #{activityId}
update seckill_activity set stock = stock -1 where activity_id = #{activityId} and stock > 0
update seckill_activity set stock = stock + 1 where activity_id = #{activityId}
